questions.q: Where to find the code and key?
questions.a: On all official SARI Système SARL documents: invoices, quotes, certificates, product labels. The code follows the format SARI-XXX##-#####.

questions.q: What does the code format mean?
questions.a: SARI (company prefix) + Type code (FAC, DVV, etc.) + Year + Sequence number. Ex: SARI-FAC24-00001 = Invoice 2024 #00001.

questions.q: What to do if the document is not recognized?
questions.a: Contact our support immediately. It could be a forgery or an entry error.
'Revoked' means the document was cancelled by us (e.g., cancelled order). 'Invalid' means the document was reported as forged or altered.

questions.q: How long do documents remain valid?
questions.a: Invoices and quotes are valid indefinitely. Certificates have a variable validity period (1 to 5 years depending on the type).
